u ∈ (0,c] with g(u) = c. Forward orbit u + n c ∈ Sc for all n ≥ 0. Intervals I_n = [u + nc − c, u + nc + c]. I_0 = [u − c, u + c] ⊇ (0, u + c] since u − c ≤ 0. Take any x ∈ S0. There is n with |x − (u + nc)| ≤ c. But (12) requires |x − (u+nc)| > c since u+nc ∈ Sc. Contradiction. Hence S0 = ∅. ✓.
